faq.title:
Frequently asked

questions.
faq.contact: Not here? <link>Write to us</link>, we reply the same day.

processing.q: How long does it take to process a video?
processing.a: A one-hour podcast takes 4 to 7 minutes. We start suggesting clips as soon as the transcription is done, so you don’t have to wait for the whole process to finish to review the first cuts.

fileFormats.a: MP4, MOV, WebM and MKV, up to 8 GB per file. You can also paste a YouTube, Google Drive or Vimeo link and we’ll download it for you.

faces.q: Does the vertical reframe cut off faces?
faces.a: No. The reframe follows the speaker frame by frame and, when there are two people, switches the framing based on who’s talking. You can always adjust the framing by hand in the editor.

editCaptions.a: Yes. The transcript is editable word by word and your changes show up in the rendered clip. You can add a dictionary of proper names so the same mistake doesn’t happen again.

afterCancel.q: What happens to my videos if I cancel?
afterCancel.a: You can download all your material for 30 days after canceling. We don’t use your content to train models or share it with third parties.

publish.q: Does Clipealo publish to my networks for me?
publish.a: Yes. You connect TikTok, Instagram or YouTube with publishing permission and pick which accounts each clip goes to: right now, or at the time you schedule, which comes with the Creator plan or above. The clip goes out from your own account, with the text you write for each platform, and the analytics come in on their own.
